_comment: Add these hooks to your Claude Code settings.json under the 'hooks' key. Adjust vault paths to match your setup.

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" == *obsidian-vaults* ]]; then echo "Remember: Update the modified field in frontmatter when editing Obsidian notes."; fi'
PreToolUse.description: Remind to update modified timestamp when editing vault notes

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" == *obsidian-vaults* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *_templates/* ]]; then python3 "$(dirname "$0")/../scripts/update-modified.py" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Auto-update modified timestamp after editing a vault note

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" == *obsidian-vaults* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *01-daily/* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *_templates/* ]]; then python3 "$(dirname "$0")/../scripts/link-to-daily.py" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Auto-link newly created notes to today's daily note

hooks.command: bash -c 'if command -v qmd &>/dev/null; then qmd embed 2>/dev/null || true; fi'

Notification.command: bash -c 'echo "Vault maintenance tip: Run vault-health-check.sh periodically to keep your vault clean."'
